action: Patients of Monadnock Community Hospital: use the hospital's website notices for service changes and be wary of unsolicited calls about your records. Other hospitals: confirm downtime procedures and diversion plans.
date_note: 16 November is the date of the hospital notice relayed by ClassAction.org; the hospital's 20 November notice says network issues began on Sunday, 8 November, and DysruptionHub (11 November) already reports the hospital confirming a cyber incident, so confirmation may predate 16 November.
exec: A small New Hampshire hospital had ambulance diversions and cancelled appointments after an IT outage, showing how a cyber incident hits patient care at rural hospitals.
impact: Network outage from 8 November with ambulance diversion and cancelled elective surgeries through 30 November, per the hospital's 20 November notice; whether data was affected is under investigation (DysruptionHub).
plain: A New Hampshire hospital's computer network went down on 8 November. The hospital says it was a cyber incident and that federal law enforcement is investigating.

sources.name: Monadnock Community Hospital, "Server Outage Update", 20 November 2026
ClassAction.org (relays hospital's November 16 notice and DysruptionHub report)

summary: Monadnock Community Hospital in New Hampshire says it first learned of network issues on Sunday, 8 November, and, once it confirmed a cyber incident, told federal law enforcement, which it says is investigating. Its 20 November notice says the hospital remains on ambulance diversion and some elective surgeries are cancelled through 30 November. DysruptionHub says the hospital is investigating whether any data was affected.
title: Monadnock Community Hospital (New Hampshire) confirms cyber incident behind network outage and ambulance diversion

validation.note: Verify desk read the hospital's own 20 Nov notice (cyber incident, federal law enforcement, diversion, cancellations to 30 Nov, outage first noticed 8 Nov) and DysruptionHub (11 Nov, updated 16 Nov); both state the cyber incident and diversion. Earlier 'November 9' start replaced by the hospital's 8 November. Data exposure not stated by the hospital.
